intermediate.name: 1st passage of the finish line
intermediate.title: Sprint | 1st passage of the finish line (161.5 km)

story: Stage 2 of the PostNord Tour of Denmark 2026 featured a 7-rider breakaway and an unsuccessful echelon attempt mid-race. Despite multiple late attacks, the stage ended in a bunch sprint. Jensen Plowright got announced as winner but the photo finish confirmed Wout van Aert finished first. Toon Aerts finished third.
